adaptations: Normalize CRLF source line endings to LF and trim trailing whitespace; retain upstream copyright and license.
Replace string.h with stddef.h in the public header for the freestanding ARM compiler.
Replace vendor memset calls with a private volatile byte loop to avoid unresolved libc functions.
Clear the aligned int32 AC coefficient array with typed word stores instead of 252 volatile byte stores per block; preserve all 63 zero coefficients and freestanding linkage.
Configure RGB565 output, no scaling, table clipping and 32-bit FASTDECODE=1.

Add an explicit geometry-only validation entry that consumes identical Huffman/DC/AC coefficients and restarts while skipping IDCT, DC pixel fill and RGB generation; preserve normal jd_decomp pixel output.

Add optional inclusive-region decoding with unchanged JDEC layout. MCUs wholly outside the region use the same entropy/geometry-only path; all raster callbacks and strict end checks remain. The jpeg_frame wrapper passes NULL pixels only for those skipped MCUs.
Compile as C++ with explicit typed pool casts and the existing C ABI; keep the upstream copyright and terms in LICENSE and omit code comments.
build_requirement: Compile with -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fwrapv. Upstream fixed-point arithmetic can overflow signed integers for malformed coefficient streams.
integration_requirement: Call through jpeg_frame.cpp, which validates bounded canonical 240x240 baseline YCbCr envelope and table lengths before jd_prepare.
supported_profile: Single scan 8-bit baseline YCbCr, component ids 1/2/3 in order, 4:4:4 / 4:2:2 / 4:2:0, quantizers 0..3 once each, Huffman tables DC0/AC0/DC1/AC1 once each, Y selector 0x00 and Cb/Cr selector 0x11. Final strict EOI and padding required.
known_scope: JPEG is lossy. Chroma replication and fixed-point IDCT differ from libjpeg fancy chroma upsampling. Component RGB565 output is canonical; target channel compensation belongs to its caller.
